We rescue, rehabilitate, re-train, and re-home horses in the Texas Panhandle who need a second chance in life. those who have been neglected, abandoned, or surrendered. We also provide compassionate care and connection for humans in need through our Equine-Assisted Learning program, Led By Horses. 

Dove Creek Equine Rescue serves what is referred to as “The Unwanted Horse Population”, horses within the domestic equine population that are no longer needed or useful, or their owners are no longer interested in or capable of providing financial or physical care. According to the Equine Rescue Network there are over 200,000 unwanted horses in the US.
